name: Caligni Eyes
text:
You replace your eyes with vat-grown visual organs modeled after the completely white eyes of calignis. The eyes absorb light that's released in a blinding flash in response to trauma.

Activate—Final Flash f (light)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger You gain the dying condition or are killed instantly

---
Effect All creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 19 Will save save or be Dazzled for 1d4 rounds; on a critical failure, they're Blinded for 1d4 rounds instead.
